about-me.title: Who?
about-me.intro: I'm a front-end focused software developer with {{year}} years of work experience in modern web and mobile development. My specialties lie in user-friendly products, where clarity, simplicity, and a pleasant user experience are most important.
about-me.middle: I put emphasis on responsiveness and visually deliberate user interfaces that serve the user intuitively. Technical skills coupled with a visual eye make me a developer who can not only build functional, but also beautiful experiences.

skills.studies-article: After a long line of assembly jobs, I decided to make a career change and go study programming. In Karelia I learned datastructures, logic, a variety of technologies and tools used in software development.
skills.internship-article: In the middle of my studies, I received an opportunity to intern for Sensire. Company in Joensuu that specializes in temperature monitoring and quality control gave their way to understanding what software development and teamwork meant outside of theoretical studies.
skills.employed-article: At the end of the internship, I was offered to continue employment at Sensire. Continuing my studies on the side, this was a great opportunity to develope skills and apply learned information from my studies.
skills.graduation-article: While working I was finalising my studies and at graduation I felt myself lucky, how I was able to create a career and working experience in such a small timespan.
